verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only a managed MCP server and an Agent Toolkit that let external MCP clients or developer-built agents call SumUp APIs. Those are developer building blocks and external-assistant integrations, not an assistant built into the product, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
